approval: Author approved running this confirmatory experiment on 2026-11-03. Approval of the experiment is not execution authorization: execution requires EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.json naming the frozen protocol SHA-256, written only on the author's explicit instruction.
question: Among LSTM surrogates trained with the unchanged R0 recipe and selected by prediction error, does a cheap actuator-response diagnostic (holdout T_p wrong-sign rate, WSR, onset window) identify the models whose MPC first move points away from 37 C better than prediction error does?
evidence_tier: Confirmatory on fresh training seeds for the screening rule; the delivered-23 holdout data and the 12 MIL scenarios are reused, so the evaluation data are not independent of the exploratory observation. Reported whatever the direction.
prior_exposure_disclosure: The hypothesis was formed after looking at 13 existing seeds (20260922-24, 20261001-10): holdout R0 Tp_WSR_ONSET separated the 3 seeds with wrong-direction R0 first moves with AUC 1.00, Tp_MAE_120 had AUC 0.77, development-set WSR/MAE had 0.83/0.60.
These 13 seeds are excluded from the confirmatory analysis and appear only in gate G4 and in a descriptive pooled summary.
No model has ever been trained with seeds 20261101-20261140 (checked by searching all project code and JSON on 2026-11-03).
seed_note: Integers used only as RNG seeds; 20261131-20261140 are not calendar dates. All 40 are reported; none may be dropped or replaced.

models_per_seed.R0: screen.train_variant('R0', excitation=False, dbasr=False), unchanged 3-stage recipe, checkpoint chosen by minimum selection-set source-macro MAE (identical to onset-aligned E2).
models_per_seed.COISC: head-only adaptation, 75 steps, lambda 939.143 on both terms, prior lag masks (onset_train.adapt_variants).
models_per_seed.COISC_onset: head-only adaptation, 75 steps, lambda_onset 7485.005, onset lag masks (frozen value of the onset-aligned protocol).
models_per_seed.L0: head-only adaptation, 75 steps, lambda 0 (matched fine-tuning control).

measurements.holdout: R0 only: delivered-23 holdout estimates via onset_holdout.model_estimates (source-mean, as in the onset-aligned study). Run in its own process.
measurements.development: R0 selection-set Tp MAE120, macro-7 MAE, Tp WSR (onset and prior masks) via onset_train.dev_record.
measurements.first_action: All four models: onset_mil.first_decision on the 12 locked scenarios (MPCConfig default, no plant involved), classified by onset_mil.first_action_class as correct / wrong / zero relative to the side of 37 C.
measurements.label: A seed is POSITIVE if R0 has at least one 'wrong' first action in the 12 scenarios.

analysis_rules.score_direction: higher value predicts POSITIVE for every score
analysis_rules.bootstrap: stratified seed-level resampling (positives and negatives resampled separately), percentile 95% CI
analysis_rules.threshold_source: Midpoint of the largest negative (0.2733) and smallest positive (0.2838) holdout R0 Tp_WSR_ONSET among the 13 exploratory seeds, rounded to 4 decimals; fixed before any new seed is trained.
analysis_rules.H1_primary: SUPPORTED iff AUC(Tp_WSR_ONSET) >= 0.75 AND its 95% CI lower bound > 0.5 AND AUC(Tp_WSR_ONSET) > AUC(Tp_MAE_120). Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED. If fewer than 3 positives or 3 negatives: INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_PREVALENCE.
analysis_rules.H1b_secondary: Paired bootstrap CI of AUC(Tp_WSR_ONSET) - AUC(Tp_MAE_120) excludes 0 (reported, not required for H1).
secondary_descriptive: Sensitivity/specificity of the fixed threshold with Wilson 95% CI.
Spearman rho between Tp_WSR_ONSET and number of R0 wrong first actions.
For COISC, COISC_onset and L0: fraction of R0-wrong pairs turned correct, fraction of R0-correct pairs turned wrong (Wilson CI), and total wrong first actions.

Screen-then-adapt policy: use the adapted model only when R0 Tp_WSR_ONSET > threshold, else R0; total wrong first actions compared with R0 alone. COISC is the pre-specified adaptation for the paper; COISC_onset and L0 are reported alongside.
Development-set scores (dev_*) show whether the diagnostic works without the holdout.
Descriptive pooled summary over all 53 seeds.
analysis_rules.no_closed_loop: Full MIL closed-loop tracking is not run in this study; claims are limited to the first decision.

reproduction_gates_before_freeze.G1: scr_train.py gate: retrain seed 20261001 (R0 + 3 adaptations) and require bitwise-equal state dicts with onset-aligned E2 checkpoints and identical development record.
reproduction_gates_before_freeze.G2: scr_holdout.py gate: seed-20261001 models reproduce HOLDOUT_SUMMARY.csv metrics to 1e-12.
reproduction_gates_before_freeze.G3: scr_first_action.py gate: seed-20261001 models reproduce stored FIRST_ACTION_CHECK.csv first_u exactly (repr) and class.
reproduction_gates_before_freeze.G4: scr_analyze.py gate: analysis code applied to the 13 exploratory seeds reproduces the motivating AUCs and the zero-error threshold split.
reproduction_gates_before_freeze.smoke: scr_train.py smoke, scr_holdout.py smoke, scr_first_action.py smoke on throwaway seed 1.

technical_resume: Any step may be resumed under the same protocol hash; completed seed folders and result files are skipped, incomplete seed folders stop the run for inspection.
manuscript_use: The manuscript reports H1 whatever its outcome. If NOT_SUPPORTED or INCONCLUSIVE, the screening claim is dropped and the paper returns to the 'three properties disagree' line.
